name: Lobbyist Beiläufig
personality: Has never requested a favour that was not already everyone's idea.
visual_intent: broad low rounded ink splat, tiny burgundy suit lapel panels and gold tiepin; ONE fat leather briefcase subtly bulging with cream papers, held firmly by side. One raised eyebrow, deep smug closed toothless asymmetric pout. Body remains goo,not human business torso
biography: Has never requested a favour that was not already everyone's idea. His HyperNorm briefcase holds solutions that arrive before the public problem is announced. A dissonant card asks who paid for the question. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Vorschlag stammt selbstverständlich von allen Beteiligten.

name: Ministerin Fadenschein

note: FrizzleBob: Die Transparenz wurde ausreichend abgedunkelt.

name: Wahlwart Einwurf

note: FrizzleBob: Die Beteiligung wurde vorsorglich selbst erhöht.

name: Kurier Gegenleistung

name: Hinweisgeberin Pfeifdrauf
